slices.behaviour: First in this record because its checks are the oldest of this attempt: red 322 and green 323 were recorded before the replay below, and it belongs to no slice because its three findings sit in three of the plan's slices at once. The fifth review passed and recorded seven findings; these are its three medium ones, all three in the rules this ticket exists to deliver rather than in the account of them. `dependency-cruiser/core-no-io` anchors the bare specifier as its three sibling deny-lists in the same file already do, so the money core cannot import an IO library that is not installed yet: a specifier resolves to a `node_modules` path once the package is installed and to the bare name while it is not, which is the state of every one of its seven libraries at this repository's root, so the clause was carrying nothing. `ast-grep/money-as-integer-cents` reads the object property and the class field a fee schedule and a tariff are written in, beside the variable declarator it already read, which are the two shapes SEEN-016 and SEEN-071 will write and the two the rule's own registry entry had been promising. And the one test that executes the staged run rather than reading it is named as a step in the CI job that installs the workspace, where before it skipped in every job: the job that runs the harness suite installs nothing and the jobs that install never ran the suite, so F21's fix was guarded in CI by two substring assertions over the script's text.
